description: Fixed plain-English descriptions of the project protocols. These describe what the matched protocol covers; they do not independently diagnose, confirm causation, or add treatments. Source pointers permit checking each description against its original record.

SCENARIO_1_HYPERCAPNIA.title: Excess carbon dioxide exposure
SCENARIO_1_HYPERCAPNIA.summary: The matched project protocol covers carbon dioxide exposure and problems with the cabin air-cleaning system.
SCENARIO_1_HYPERCAPNIA.technical_title: Acute and Chronic Hypercapnia (CO2 Toxicity & ECLSS Scrubbing Degradation)

SCENARIO_2_SANS.title: Spaceflight-related vision changes
SCENARIO_2_SANS.summary: The matched project protocol covers vision and eye changes associated with spaceflight.

SCENARIO_3_ORTHOSTATIC_INTOLERANCE.title: Feeling faint during a gravity change
SCENARIO_3_ORTHOSTATIC_INTOLERANCE.summary: The matched project protocol covers blood-pressure and faintness problems during a change in gravity.
SCENARIO_3_ORTHOSTATIC_INTOLERANCE.technical_title: Orthostatic Intolerance and Gravitational Transition Pre-Syncope

SCENARIO_4_SOLAR_RADIATION_ARS.title: Possible effects of a radiation event
SCENARIO_4_SOLAR_RADIATION_ARS.summary: The matched project protocol covers radiation exposure during a solar particle event.
SCENARIO_4_SOLAR_RADIATION_ARS.technical_title: Acute Radiation Syndrome (ARS) from Solar Particle Event (SPE)

SCENARIO_5_EVA_THERMAL_DCS.title: Possible heat, fluid-loss or pressure-change problems
SCENARIO_5_EVA_THERMAL_DCS.summary: This combined project protocol covers several possible spacewalk problems. Its title alone does not identify which one explains the observations.
SCENARIO_5_EVA_THERMAL_DCS.technical_title: EVA Thermal Strain ('Space Fever'), Dehydration, and Decompression Sickness (DCS)

SCENARIO_6_CIRCADIAN_SLEEP.title: Disrupted sleep and fatigue
SCENARIO_6_CIRCADIAN_SLEEP.summary: The matched project protocol covers disrupted sleep timing, broken sleep and fatigue.
SCENARIO_6_CIRCADIAN_SLEEP.technical_title: Circadian Desynchrony, Sleep Architecture Fragmentation, and Behavioral Asthenia

SCENARIO_7_IJV_THROMBOSIS_ARRHYTHMIA.title: Possible neck-vein clot or abnormal heart rhythm
SCENARIO_7_IJV_THROMBOSIS_ARRHYTHMIA.summary: This combined project protocol covers vein clots and heart-rhythm problems. Its title alone does not establish which one is present.
SCENARIO_7_IJV_THROMBOSIS_ARRHYTHMIA.technical_title: Spaceflight Venous Thromboembolism (IJV Thrombosis) and Cardiac Arrhythmia

SCENARIO_8_SAS_URINARY_RETENTION.title: Early-flight adaptation, sinus or urinary problems
SCENARIO_8_SAS_URINARY_RETENTION.summary: This combined project protocol covers space adaptation symptoms, sinus problems and trouble passing urine. Its title alone does not establish which one is present.
SCENARIO_8_SAS_URINARY_RETENTION.technical_title: Early-Mission Space Adaptation Syndrome (SAS), Rhinosinusitis, and Acute Urinary Retention

CPG-01.title: Possible appendix problem
CPG-01.summary: The matched project protocol checks lower-right belly pain, fever, blood tests and an appendix scan.

CPG-02.title: Possible heart attack
CPG-02.summary: The matched project protocol checks chest pain and changes on a heart recording.

CPG-03.title: Possible cardiac arrest
CPG-03.summary: The matched project protocol covers a person who is unresponsive, not breathing and has no pulse.

CPG-04.title: Possible clot in a neck vein
CPG-04.summary: The matched project protocol checks neck symptoms and blood flow in the neck veins using ultrasound.

CPG-05.title: Possible fast or irregular heartbeat
CPG-05.summary: The matched project protocol checks a fast or irregular heartbeat and the heart recording.

CPG-06.title: Spaceflight-related vision changes
CPG-06.summary: The matched project protocol checks blurred near vision and changes seen on eye measurements or scans.

CPG-07.title: Excess carbon dioxide exposure
CPG-07.summary: The matched project protocol checks carbon dioxide exposure, breathing symptoms and reported headache or slowed thinking.

CPG-08.title: Possible illness from a pressure change
CPG-08.summary: The matched project protocol checks a pressure drop together with joint pain, tingling, dizziness or changes in brain and nerve function.

CPG-09.title: Possible effects of radiation exposure
CPG-09.summary: The matched project protocol checks radiation exposure, nausea or vomiting, and changes in blood counts.
CPG-09.technical_title: Acute Radiation Syndrome (ARS) / Solar Particle Event (SPE)

CPG-10.title: Possible ammonia exposure
CPG-10.summary: The matched project protocol checks an ammonia or coolant leak with eye irritation and breathing symptoms.

CPG-11.title: Possible exposure to spacecraft propellant
CPG-11.summary: The matched project protocol checks possible hydrazine contamination and irritation of the breathing passages or other reported symptoms.

CPG-12.title: Possible smoke or carbon monoxide exposure
CPG-12.summary: The matched project protocol checks fire or smoke exposure with headache, confusion or breathing changes. Its notes warn that the oxygen reading may appear normal.
CPG-12.technical_title: Carbon Monoxide (CO) / Spacecraft Fire Smoke Inhalation

CPG-13.title: Motion sickness during space adaptation
CPG-13.summary: The matched project protocol covers nausea, vomiting and disorientation during early adjustment to low gravity or a gravity change.
CPG-13.technical_title: Space Motion Sickness (SMS) / Space Adaptation Syndrome

CPG-14.title: Feeling faint during a gravity change
CPG-14.summary: The matched project protocol checks a blood-pressure drop, a faster pulse and faintness around landing or a change in gravity.

CPG-15.title: Possible overheating
CPG-15.summary: The matched project protocol checks suit cooling or workload problems together with a high body temperature and other symptoms.

CPG-16.title: Possible kidney stone
CPG-16.summary: The matched project protocol checks severe pain on one side of the back or side of the body, urinary symptoms and an ultrasound scan.

CPG-17.title: Trouble passing urine
CPG-17.summary: The matched project protocol checks inability to pass urine, lower-belly discomfort and a bladder scan.

CPG-18.title: Possible urinary infection
CPG-18.summary: The matched project protocol checks painful or frequent urination, with fever or pain in the side of the body in some presentations.

CPG-19.title: Possible lung infection or severe infection
CPG-19.summary: The matched project protocol checks fever, cough, breathing changes, blood pressure and laboratory findings.

CPG-20.title: Possible severe allergic reaction
CPG-20.summary: The matched project protocol checks a sudden allergic reaction involving skin changes, swelling, breathing problems or low blood pressure.

CPG-21.title: Eye and breathing irritation after dust exposure
CPG-21.summary: The matched project protocol checks dust exposure after a spacewalk with eye irritation, sneezing or wheezing.

CPG-22.title: Possible scratch or particle injury to the eye
CPG-22.summary: The matched project protocol checks eye pain, light sensitivity, tearing and an eye examination.

CPG-23.title: Possible tooth infection or pressure-related tooth pain
CPG-23.summary: The matched project protocol checks tooth pain, swelling, tenderness, fever or pain during a pressure change.

CPG-24.title: Possible skin or nearby tissue infection
CPG-24.summary: The matched project protocol checks spreading redness, warmth, tenderness, swelling or pus.

CPG-25.title: Possible shingles
CPG-25.summary: The matched project protocol checks a painful blistering rash on one side of the body, sometimes preceded by burning or tingling.

CPG-26.title: Possible fungal skin rash
CPG-26.summary: The matched project protocol checks an itchy, scaly or moist rash in the described skin areas.

CPG-27.title: Muscle or joint strain after activity
CPG-27.summary: The matched project protocol checks shoulder, wrist or lower-back strain after a spacewalk or resistance exercise.
CPG-27.technical_title: EVA Musculoskeletal Strain / Suit Shoulder Injury

CPG-28.title: Possible internal injury or bleeding
CPG-28.summary: The matched project protocol checks a significant impact or crush injury, ultrasound findings and laboratory changes.

CPG-29.title: Possible stomach or bowel infection
CPG-29.summary: The matched project protocol covers watery diarrhoea, stomach cramps and nausea.

CPG-30.title: Constipation or slowed bowel movements
CPG-30.summary: The matched project protocol checks less frequent bowel movements and mild bloating without the listed warning symptoms.

CPG-31.title: Disrupted sleep timing or trouble sleeping
CPG-31.summary: The matched project protocol checks sleep timing, difficulty falling asleep, short sleep and environmental factors.

CPG-32.title: Fatigue after a long shift or too little sleep
CPG-32.summary: The matched project protocol checks extended work, sleep loss and slower reaction time.
